notes.title: Patch 1.3
notes.content:
Patch 1.3 includes: 
-Completion percentage on Main Menu screen
-New Lore elements found in various locations
-Visual and audio aids in game. 
-Balancing out bots a bit more

-Announcement of more to come!

notes.title: Update ver 1.2
notes.content:
-Balanced Bot times with bot difficulty (How often a bot breaks down)
-Fixed Employee Handbook interface, now everything should be visible. 
-Balanced Larry and Boss timer better at lower difficulties.
